made.summary: Off-site DB backup is a manual monthly owner step for v1; scheduled encrypted backup is ROADMAP R-2
Sessions are excluded from backups; a restored site requires logging in again
In-range dependency updates were not applied: they did not fix the build-time-only moderate advisories
Default share image is a branded card (public/og-card.jpg); album pages keep their own cover photo
Owner scripts print only a redacted message on failure, because Node's own error output can echo the database password
Photos and albums get Move earlier/later buttons so reordering does not require dragging (WCAG 2.5.7)
20 moderate advisories are build or dev time only and have no non-downgrade fix; recorded as accepted risk pending the owner's decision
The verified database backup copy on K:\ stays unencrypted; the owner accepts the risk of exposing contact data and the admin password hash if someone accesses that drive
Firefox/WebKit tests serve the built site over HTTPS with a throwaway certificate because WebKit refuses Secure cookies on http://localhost; the PR suite stays on HTTP
GitHub dependency review removed from CI until the owner turns on the Dependency graph; the npm audit policy covers the lockfile meanwhile

constraints: Non-commercial showcase: no prices, packages, booking or sales
Free tiers only, no card on file (Vercel Hobby, Neon Free, B2 free, Resend free)
Never run destructive tests against production; restores only into new empty databases
Release approval belongs to Joshua Small
